sources.text: The Transparency Service MUST also check the Signed Statement includes the required protected headers.
The protected header of the COSE_Sign1 Envelope MUST include either the Issuer's certificate as `x5t` or the chain including the Issuer's certificate as `x5chain`, as defined in {{RFC9360}}.
The `CWT Claims` value MUST include the `Issuer Claim` (Claim label 1) and the `Subject Claim` (Claim label 2) {{IANA.cwt}}.
Label `258` (payload hash alg) MUST be present in the protected header and MUST NOT be present in the unprotected header.

r3/x-a-only.note: every required protected header is present; admission depends on the service's registration policy
